data.exact_reserve_text: Overall premium for the year has decreased to GBP 387.8m (2017: GBP 396.6m), with the loss for the financial year of GBP 25.0m reflecting the challenging market conditions currently being faced, higher than expected attritional losses in the current accident year and deterioration in prior year losses, predominantly Professional Indemnity.
data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 647.346m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 82.9m (around 12.8% of opening reserves), driven by adverse development on older underwriting years. The Managing Agent cites deterioration in prior year losses (predominantly Professional Indemnity) and higher than expected attritional claims as contributing factors. The prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development table in the Technical Provisions note.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration in prior year losses, predominantly Professional Indemnity
higher than expected attritional losses in the current accident year
Claims development is shown in the tables below, both gross and net of reinsurance ceded, on an underwriting year basis

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (GBP 82.874m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (Technical Provisions note) by comparing the latest estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years up to 2016 and summing the changes. No explicit single-line gross 'prior year movement' sentence was provided; narrative gives only a net description ('deterioration in prior year losses, predominantly Professional Indemnity'). The technical provisions table shows a total change in claims outstanding (gross 118,158) which includes current year movements and FX effects; therefore the triangle was used as primary source. LOB-level movement amounts are not quantified in the report and have been inferred where textual commentary exists.
